question: Who among the following has become the youngest Mayor of Thiruvananthapuram Corporation, Kerala, in December 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Arya Rajendran**__.

__
 
• **Arya Rajendran has become the youngest Mayor of Thiruvananthapuram Corporation, Kerala, in December 2020.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Arya Rajendran: **

 
 
• She is the mayor of the Thiruvananthapuram Corporation.
 
• She is **22 years old** (born 12 January 1999).
 
• She was elected from **Mudavanmukal ward **which belongs to **Nemom Assembly Constituency** from **Communist Party of India (Marxist)**.
 
• At the **age of 21** and was appointed as the mayor of the Thiruvananthapuram Corporation.
 
• She is the **youngest mayor in the country.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5c985562e465bd49139f0f38b4c63fefb4bf471c720e232cfd023e541b35b09e.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sanjeev Ganesh** Naik became the** first mayor of the satellite city of** **Navi Mumbai at the age of 23. **
 
• **Sabitha Beegam **is the **first Muslim Mayor in India**.
 
 
• She is also the **first mayor of Kollam Corporation** at the** age of 23. **
